Yeah, that's right. So direct and honest.
That's that character I wrote.

The story doesn't matter! If we can change 
that, then this reality will become genuine!

<CLT=cltMIND>That's right. If we can change reality...
Then my feelings won't be fictional anymore...<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm going to believe in Shuichi...
If he was here, that's what he would do...

It's just as you said. Those who died 
wish for their friends to live on...

That's not it! In order to connect everyone's
thoughts, I'm going to use my life!

<CLT=cltMIND>That's right. If we can change reality...
Then my feelings won't be fictional anymore...<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm going to believe in Shuichi...
If he was here, that's what he would do...

Even if my existence is a work of fiction...
Just a piece of story written by someone...

If we can change that reality,
then it won't be fictional anymore!

<CLT=cltMIND>That's right. If we can change reality... 
Then my feelings won't be fictional anymore...<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm going to believe in Shuichi...
If he was here, that's what he would do...

<CLT=cltMIND>I'll end this killing game...
I'll believe in my feelings!
